title:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: title-screen background artwork for Lanternfall, an original mobile fantasy roguelike.
Primary request: exactly one portrait image, 1024 x 1536 pixels, no text and no user interface. A breathtaking richly detailed pixel-art fantasy ancient underground gate overgrown with blue moss, a warm glowing huge lantern hanging in the arch, a tiny teal-cloak red-scarf adventurer seen from behind at the bottom, a green slime among mushrooms near the adventurer's feet, and distant glowing blue ruins.
Style/medium: premium richly detailed handcrafted painterly pixel art, charming and slightly eerie fantasy JRPG adventure mood, cinematic composition, original designs with no franchise copying.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, enormous ancient arch and lantern forming the focus in the middle and lower area; the tiny adventurer provides scale; keep the upper third dark with restful negative space suitable for a game title overlay. Impressive subterranean depth visible through and around the ruins, inviting discovery.
Lighting/mood: warm huge amber lantern lighting ancient stone, cool turquoise bioluminescent moss and mushrooms, mysterious deep navy shadows.
Color palette: deep navy, turquoise, warm amber.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no border, no logos, no watermark. Complete richly illustrated background with the top third remaining dark and visually quiet.
